problem:
$$
B=[\begin{aligned}1 & -3 & 2 \\ 5 & -10 & 7 \\ -3 & 9 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

If $B=LU$ is the LU decomposition of the matrix $B$ given above, what is the value of ${l}_{21}\cdot {u}_{23}?$
worked_solution:
Let's apply our standard LU factorization algorithm.

We reduce the matrix $B$ to row echelon form to obtain the matrix $U,$ as usual. However, instead of writing zeros below the main diagonal, we will instead write down the entries of the matrix $L.$

$$
\begin{aligned}B & =[\begin{aligned}1 & -3 & 2 \\ 5 & -10 & 7 \\ -3 & 9 & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+(-5){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -3 & 2 \\ \,\,5\,\, & 5 & -3 \\ -3 & 9 & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+3{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -3 & 2 \\ \,\,5\,\, & 5 & -3 \\ -3 & 0 & 7\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we obtain

$$
L=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 5 & 1 & 0 \\ -3 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}],\,U=[\begin{aligned}1 & -3 & 2 \\ 0 & 5 & -3 \\ 0 & 0 & 7\end{aligned}].
$$

Finally, since ${l}_{21}=5$ and ${u}_{23}=-3,$ we get

$$
{l}_{21}\cdot {u}_{23}=5\cdot (-3)=-15.
$$
